'''Alan Crawford's Female Associate''' is a minor character in {{SA}}.

==History==
===Background===
Nothing is known about her background except that at one point she got together with music manager [[Alan Crawford]] who manages rapper [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
In the [[Missions in GTA San Andreas|mission]] [[Management Issues]], she and Alan are kidnapped and killed by [[Carl Johnson]] under orders of [[OG Loc (3D Universe)|Jeffrey "OG Loc" Cross]] in an attempt to sabotage Madd Dogg's career. Carl Johnson steals the [[Elegant]] scheduled to pick her and Crawford up, and then, after an awards ceremony, drives the car into the sea, [[Bail Out|bailing out]] just before the car enters the [[water]].

==Character==
===Appearance===
Her pedestrian model is a generic Hispanic rich woman who can be seen in affluent areas of [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]] and [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]].

==Prominent Appearances in Gameplay==
*[[Management Issues]] <small>(Killed)</small>
